value: Visual novel game inspired by Oyayubihime where you interact with a giant girl who is keeping you and several others as pets. Includes several types of minigames.

You have been kidnapped by Saeko, a female university student, and appointed as the new “supervisor” of her imprisoned tinies. Your decisions affect her mood, and subsequently the fate of the other tinies.
SAFE HAVN STUDIO: newkyp, koh9083, kmaztani
